source: primary working tree including pre-existing local changes

live_dependency.description: sys_mmap private file mapping still holds KERNEL_VFS and reads through the kernel VFS under the scheduler and PMM locks

contract.offset: arg0, explicit absolute u64; unrepresentable offset or offset+length is EINVAL before any backend call
contract.length: arg1, 1..=4096; zero or larger is a codec error
contract.identity: owner and token select the retained description; mismatch is EBADF
contract.cursor: never read, written or restored; no seek is issued
contract.eof: at or past EOF returns zero bytes with errno 0; short reads reported unchanged

compilation.note: an earlier attempt was killed by SIGTERM and left a stale incremental object that failed to link; rebuilt without source change

compilation.command: RUSTFLAGS='-C link-arg=-Tservices/user-space.ld -C relocation-model=static -C target-cpu=x86-64-v2 -C no-redzone' cargo build --release -p sunlight-vfs-server

covers: cursor preservation across read, seek and SEEK_CURRENT
duplicates share one cursor with independent positional reads
foreign caller, incarnation and address space
rename and unlink retention with replacement at the old path
retire_file_owner releases it and the backend pin
epoch withdrawal releases and fails old tokens

kernel client that parks for the reply outside SCHEDULER, PMM and KERNEL_VFS
